listing.name: Microforge
listing.summary: Provides a framework for mods to patch the game's Java classes at runtime using source-level edits.
listing.aiSummary: Provides a framework for mods to patch the game's Java classes at runtime using source-level edits.

description: At startup, Microforge collects patches from all enabled mods that declare patches, checks them for conflicts, compiles the changed classes into one cached replacement jar, and then starts Starsector. Compatible edits (even separate edits to the same source file) can coexist. Conflicting edits stop startup with an error identifying the affected mods.
descriptionHtml: At startup, Microforge collects patches from all enabled mods that declare patches, checks them for conflicts, compiles the changed classes into one cached replacement jar, and then starts Starsector. Compatible edits (even separate edits to the same source file) can coexist. Conflicting edits stop startup with an error identifying the affected mods.
aiDescription: Provides a framework for mods to patch the game's Java classes at runtime using source-level edits. Allows multiple mods to safely apply changes to the same game files without conflicts. Compiles patches using a robust Java compiler and caches results for faster startup. Enables advanced modding capabilities beyond the standard API.

changelog.1.0.1: Fixed a bug where the mod would fail to compile patches if a mod had a malformed patch file.
